_doc: Pro liquid sets (eval/pro_beatmelody.json, 77 transitions, 4 sets): share of drum behaviour across transitions -> soft prior cost per BM candidate group in blend_loop (cost += BM_PRIOR_W * prior; prior = -ln(share/max share), share floored at 0.05). Weights only, never a gate. Groups: continuous = beat carried (fam_C*, fam_AC*), drop = beat cut into melody (fam_A*), melody = melody cross (fam_B*), fade = slow beat fade (no fix, BM1 case).
_cap_note: 2026-11-02 19:20 ET: melody (fam_B) prior capped at the drop prior (was 2.622 from the 0.05 floor: 0 pro transitions measured as melody-cross is a detector artefact, not evidence). the listener's 06v2 26:16 pick was AC_ib_plus_cut (ratings.jsonl), so continuous stays cheapest; B stays a live option.
